Animated face artwork: Minicons Animated by Tanzim Siam.
Source: https://github.com/tanximsiam/minicons-animated
License: MIT. See LICENSE in this directory.

Files included: angry.svg, anxious.svg, curious.svg, embarrassed.svg,
joyful.svg, neutral.svg, proud.svg, sad.svg, surprised.svg, unimpressed.svg.
neutral-static.svg is a local static copy derived from neutral.svg for the
participant speaking turn; the experiment does not draw a separate mouth over
the face artwork.
